textContent.text: Theo's tail swished as he practiced blowing on his set of pipes. Theo was a centaur—a magical creature that was half man and half horse. And like many other centaurs in Centaur Hills, Theo wanted to win King Cosmos's music contest and play at the royal birthday ball. If only he could block out the sound of his brother Arkadi! Whenever Arkadi was upset, he tapped his little hooves on their cave's stone floor.
"Teach me to play your panpipe," Arkadi demanded. His hooves tap-tap-tapped.
"Not now. The contest is in less than a week. I need to keep practicing, so stop clomping your feet."
Arkadi looked glum. "Please!"
"After the contest," Theo said.
"Can I just try it once?" Arkadi tugged on the panpipe. "Please?"
Arkadi tried to pull it out of Theo's hand, but he tripped and fell. The panpipe flew into the air, and when it crashed, one of its pipes fell off.
"No!" Theo cried.
"I'm sorry!" Arkadi wailed and galloped out of sight.
Theo picked up the broken panpipe and examined it.

textContent.text: Uh-oh. Nissa had forgotten to check her apron pockets, and she'd brought fairy dust by mistake! Of course, it was against the rules, but Wizard Wendell probably wouldn't notice if she used a tiny amount. Fairy dust made cookies crisper, pudding creamier, and frosting fluffier. If Nissa sprinkled a little on her gingerbread walls, the cracks would disappear in a flash.

Nissa held a pinch of fairy dust over the pan of gingerbread. But right before she opened her fingers, she heard Godmother Marigold's voice in her head. Marigold always said, "If you want to be a great baker, you must practice hard and learn from your mistakes. You can't depend on shortcuts like fairy dust."
Slowly, Nissa returned the fairy dust to her pocket and went to the sink to wash her hands.
"Toadstools," she muttered grumpily. She was going to lose.

Of course, it was against the rules, but Wizard Wendell probably wouldn't notice if she used a tiny amount. Fairy dust made cookies crisper, pudding creamier, and frosting fluffier. If Nissa sprinkled a little on her gingerbread walls, the cracks would disappear in a flash.

Nissa held a pinch of fairy dust over the pan of gingerbread. But right before she opened her fingers, she heard Godmother Marigold's voice in her head. Marigold always said, "If you want to be a great baker, you must practice hard and learn from your mistakes. You can't depend on shortcuts like fairy dust."
Slowly, Nissa returned the fairy dust to her pocket and went to the sink to wash her hands.
"Toadstools," she muttered grumpily. She was going to lose.

elements.text: To be prepared for problems in space, astronauts have to take many classes.

contents.text: <instructions>Choose the main, or central, idea that ties all the details together.</instructions>

contents.text: If you don't know the meaning of a word, you can look for context clues. Context clues are nearby words and phrases that help you figure out the meaning of an unknown word.

header.text: Here are some examples:

sentences.text: Janet's dog punctured her ball with his teeth, causing it to go flat.
You can guess that punctured means "made a hole in."
She had a map, so she offered to be the trip's navigator.
You can guess that a navigator is someone who gives directions on a journey.
